_comment:
Ranked comparison lists. Each block is one coloured band and one card. `party` is a template code and supplies the bar colour. `format` is "share" for a percentage or "pp" for a percentage-point change. `max` is the width the bars are scaled against, set a little above the largest value including the one this election is likely to produce, so the pending bar still reads against the list.

`pending` is this election's own row, drawn dashed until real figures exist. Its `value` is the current polling average, replaced by the exit poll once one is published: `institute` is matched against the first column of the exit-poll Sheet tab, so "Infratest dimap" finds the row labelled "Infratest dimap for ARD". For a "pp" block, `baseline` is the figure the exit poll is compared against.

Comparator rows are second-vote shares from certified results in German state elections. Saxony-Anhalt 2026 is included: it was held two weeks before this election and reset the top of both AfD lists.

blocks.label: AfD (ESN) · Best State Election Results
blocks.heading: The AfD (ESN)'s five strongest state-election results to date
blocks.sub: Second-vote share, all German state (regional parliament) elections
blocks.note: The AfD has led or tied the lead in every Mecklenburg-Vorpommern poll published this year. The 2026 row shows the Infratest dimap exit poll once published; until then it reflects the current polling average, which would place it second on this list behind Saxony-Anhalt two weeks earlier.

blocks.label: AfD (ESN) · Biggest Vote-Share Gains
blocks.heading: The AfD (ESN)'s five biggest gains vs. the previous election
blocks.sub: Percentage-point change in second-vote share, all German state (regional parliament) elections
blocks.note: The 2026 row shows the gain implied by the Infratest dimap exit poll against the AfD's 16.7% in 2021, once published; until then it reflects the current polling swing.

blocks.label: CDU (EPP) · Record Lows
blocks.heading: The CDU (EPP)'s lowest state-election results
blocks.sub: Second-vote share · the party's weakest showings since its founding in 1950
blocks.note: The CDU took 13.3% in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern in 2021 and has polled between 6% and 10% since the summer. The 2026 row shows the Infratest dimap exit poll once published; until then it reflects the current polling average, which would be the lowest result the CDU has recorded in any state election.
